mapper.select: /* com.mtf.kibs.mapper.AiClippingMapper.selectClippingArticlesForList */ SELECT seq, clipping_seq AS clippingSeq, keyword, title, link, publisher, DATE_FORMAT(article_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS articleDate, relevance_score AS relevanceScore, status, topic_no AS topicNo FROM ai_clipping_article WHERE clipping_seq = #{clippingSeq} AND status IN ('SELECTED', 'LISTED') ORDER BY article_date DESC, relevance_score DESC, seq ASC

/* com.mtf.kibs.mapper.AiClippingMapper.selectClippingArticlesAll */ SELECT seq, clipping_seq AS clippingSeq, keyword, title, link, publisher, summary, DATE_FORMAT(article_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS articleDate, relevance_score AS relevanceScore, status, topic_no AS topicNo, DATE_FORMAT(reg_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS regDate FROM ai_clipping_article WHERE clipping_seq = #{clippingSeq} ORDER BY FIELD(status, 'SELECTED', 'LISTED', 'EXCLUDED_SCORE', 'EXCLUDED_BLACKLIST'), relevance_score DESC, article_date DESC
